Container.Name: shortcircuit
Container.Overview: Self-hosted URL shortener and link management. Docker Manager downloads the versioned preview image. Use an SSH tunnel for the default loopback ports or configure a private reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Public hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames or IP addresses for public redirects. Enter names or addresses without a scheme or port.

Config.Name: Admin origin
Config.Description: Exact address used by the browser for administration. The localhost default is for local or tunneled access. For LAN access, enter the HTTPS proxy address and forward HTTP to container port 8081. An HTTP LAN origin prevents startup.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Comma-separated IP addresses or CIDR networks of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted, for example the Nginx Proxy Manager bridge network 172.18.0.0/16. Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: Backup interval
Config.Description: Scheduled backup interval in hours. Backups are written to /data/backups/scheduled in the same volume, so also copy them to other storage. Use 0 to disable automatic backups.

Config.Name: Scheduled backups to keep
Config.Description: Number of verified scheduled backups to retain.
